prompt: Your friend Mariana asks what happened at the café last night. Text her two short sentences: what the weather was like and the sudden thing that happened.

constraints.label: use the imperfect for the weather
use de repente for the sudden event
use the preterite for what happened

model: Llovía mucho cuando salí del café. De repente se fue la luz.

prompt: Vale called while you were working, and you didn't answer. Text her two short sentences (she's your age, so tú): what you were doing when she called, and how you felt.

constraints.label: say what you were doing: estaba + -ando/-iendo
use llamaste (you called)

model: Estaba cerrando el café cuando llamaste. Estaba muy cansado.

prompt: Your older neighbour, whom you call usted, saw you running down the street at seven this morning with a tinto in your hand. Explain in two short sentences what you were doing and why.

constraints.label: use estaba (I was)
estaba + -ando/-iendo
past, not present

model: Estaba corriendo detrás del bus. Era muy tarde y tenía una reunión.

prompt: Vale asks you in a message if tomorrow will be a good day for the café. Reply in two sentences: say what you think about the weather, and what Mariana says.

constraints.label: say what you think: creo que...
pass on what Mariana says: dice que...

model: Creo que mañana va a llover. Mariana dice que va a hacer mucho frío.

prompt: Don Hernando, whom you call usted, asks how your last birthday was. Tell him in two short sentences what the day was like and one thing that happened.

constraints.label: use the imperfect for what the day was like
use the preterite for what happened
mention a gift

model: Hacía sol y todo era bonito. Mi mamá me dio un regalo.

prompt: Last night you heard the noise at the back of the café again. Text Vale two short sentences (she's your age, so tú): say it happened again, and name one thing you will never do again.

constraints.label: use volver a + infinitive for again

model: Anoche el ruido volvió a empezar. No vuelvo a cerrar solo.

prompt: Mariana is in Medellín and asks what Bogotá is like today. Text her two short sentences about the weather (she's your age, so tú).

constraints.label: use hace for the weather
use está lloviendo or está nublado

model: Hoy hace frío y está lloviendo. Yo estoy en el café con un tinto.

prompt: Don Hernando, whom you call usted, asks what you did last night. Answer in two short sentences: what you did, and what the weather was like.

constraints.label: use cerré (I closed)
use llovía (it was raining)
cerré, not cerraba, for one finished action

model: Anoche cerré el café a las diez. Llovía mucho y no había nadie.

prompt: Mariana asks what everyone was doing in the photo from the birthday party. Text her two or three short sentences about what two or three people were doing.

constraints.label: say what at least two people were doing
mention someone from the café

model: Vale estaba cortando el pan y Simón estaba gritando. Yo estaba tomando fotos.

prompt: You tell Vale (she's your age, so tú) about the night of the noise. In two short sentences, say what you knew and what you thought was going on.

constraints.label: use que twice, once for each clause
use the imperfect for what you knew and thought

model: Sabía que alguien estaba en la cocina. Creía que era un cliente.

prompt: Your friend Vale asks if the weather yesterday was worse than today. Reply with two short sentences comparing yesterday with today.

constraints.label: compare with más or menos ... que
mention yesterday or today
use the imperfect for yesterday's weather

model: Ayer llovía más que hoy. Y hacía más frío.

prompt: Vale tells you that Simón talked to the stranger last night. Text her back (she's your age, so tú): show surprise, ask what happened, and say thank goodness.

constraints.label: ask a question
react with ¿En serio? or ¿De verdad?
ask ¿Y qué pasó?

model: ¿En serio? ¿Y qué pasó después? Menos mal.

prompt: Don Hernando, whom you call usted, asks for a story from your life. Tell him a short story in two or three sentences: something that happened once, and how it ended.

constraints.label: start with una vez
end with al final
use the preterite for what happened

model: Una vez, en Toronto, perdí mi celular. Al final lo encontré en el bus.

prompt: Mariana asks how you felt when you heard the noise. Text her two short sentences (she's your age, so tú): how you felt, and what was going on.

constraints.label: name a feeling
use estaba (I was)

model: Estaba muy asustado cuando oí el ruido. Vale estaba preocupada también.

prompt: Officer Ríos, a stranger you call usted, asks you to describe the man. Write two short sentences: what you think about him, and what he was doing.

constraints.label: use creo que or vi que
use the imperfect for what he was doing

model: Creo que el hombre llevaba una gorra. Vi que corría rápido.

prompt: Don Hernando, whom you call usted, asks why you were late to the café this morning. Answer in two or three short sentences: what the weather was like and what you did in the end.

constraints.label: use the imperfect for the weather
use the preterite for what you did
use al final

model: Llovía mucho y hacía frío. Al final tomé un taxi.

prompt: Your brother wasn't at your cousin's birthday. Text him two short sentences: how the party was (use the imperfect) and one thing that happened (use the preterite).

constraints.label: use the imperfect for how the party was
use the preterite for what happened

model: La fiesta era muy bonita. Mi tío me dio un regalo.

prompt: Your friend Mariana asks which is better, Vale's café or Rosa's café. Reply with two short sentences comparing them.

constraints.label: compare with más or menos ... que

model: El café de Rosa es más pequeño que el café de Vale. Pero es más bonito.

prompt: A friend your age asks if the book or the movie was better. Reply in two short sentences: say what the movie was like (imperfect) and compare it with the book.

constraints.label: compare with más/menos ... que or mejor/peor que
use the imperfect for what the movie was like

model: La película era más corta que el libro. Pero fue mejor.

prompt: Your friend Vale asks why you didn't hear the phone. Text her two short sentences: what you were doing (use estaba + -ando/-iendo) and what happened then (preterite).

constraints.label: say what you were doing: estaba + -ando/-iendo
use the preterite for what happened

model: Estaba comiendo en la cocina. De repente llegó mi hermano.

prompt: Tell your mother (tú) about last night's storm in two short sentences: what it was doing when you got home, and what you did.

constraints.label: say what was going on: estaba + -ando/-iendo
use the preterite for what you did

model: Estaba lloviendo mucho cuando llegué a casa. Entré rápido.
